Jabre Capital Partners Sa Raised Its Advanced Micro Devices (Call) (AMD) Position by $10.50 Million; Stock Price Declined; Greenhill & Co (GHL) Share Value Declined While Bridgecreek Investment Management Has Decreased by $550,905 Its Stake 
April 23, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Philippe Jabre increased its stake in Advanced Micro Devices Inc (Call) (AMD) by 175% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jabre Capital Partners Sa bought 1.05M shares as the company’s stock declined 5.12% with the market. The hedge fund run by Philippe Jabre held 1.65 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.96M, up from 600,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jabre Capital Partners Sa who had been investing in Advanced Micro Devices Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.19% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $9.99. About 39.01M shares traded. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) has declined 27.01% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.56% the S&P500. 
Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Greenhill & Co Inc (GHL) by 13.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc sold 28,995 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.28% with the market. The institutional investor held 192,350 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.75M, down from 221,345 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Greenhill & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $542.62M market cap company. (NYSE:GHL) has declined 36.41% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 47.96% the S&P500.
